description: 水利署水庫警告設施設置圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 強化我國民眾從事水域遊憩活動之安全資訊，擴大公私部門水域事故防災地圖資料之整合，並參照政府資料開放平臺之資料開放（Open Data）精神，本資料收集石門、曾文等具觀光遊憩活動之水庫，水庫庫區警告標示牌、救生圈、救生站(含AED)等位址相關資料，提供民眾了解相關警告設施、救生圈及救生站位置，並作為管理機關盤點檢查、更新及評估增設依據，另可... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
